allocation: $100 spot long + equal base-asset quantity USD-M perpetual short backed by $100 isolated margin + $50 reserve

decision_rule.frequency: First UTC day of each month at 00:00; planned execution at the 01:00 hourly open
decision_rule.information_cutoff: Completed prior calendar-month funding and daily spot closes through the prior UTC day only
qualification: Prior calendar-month funding sum >= 50 bps, the complete stress round-trip cost
Last completed daily spot close > EMA50 of completed daily spot closes
decision_rule.selection: Among qualified assets select the highest prior-month funding sum; deterministic symbol tie-break
decision_rule.requalification: Every month retain only if still selected; otherwise switch or exit to cash
decision_rule.missing_execution_bar: If either required spot/perpetual leg lacks a real exact-time bar, execute both legs atomically at their first common real hourly open within 168 hours; otherwise retain the current state and report the skipped action

position.quantity_hedge: Exact equal base-asset quantity, not equal dollar notional when basis is non-zero
position.intramonth_exit: None in this frozen diagnostic; monthly requalification only

data.source: Public anonymous Binance Data Vision monthly archives
data.perpetual_mark: USD-M mark-price 1h OHLC; if a verified 1h archive omits an hour, use the exact same timestamp open from the verified public 1m mark archive; where both mark resolutions are absent, use only the exact same-hour perpetual open as a disclosed mark proxy
data.spot_ema_warmup_start: 2020-08-01 archive request; SOLUSDT begins at its first archived trade on 2020-08-11 06:00 UTC, leaving 143 completed daily closes before the first decision
data.integrity: Every archive and .CHECKSUM must exist and match before parsing; absent 1h observations first use exact same-timestamp verified 1m observations
data.pre_result_gap_policy: Frozen after archive-quality inspection but before any target, episode or PnL was computed: exact lower-timeframe observations repair sparse 1h omissions. A monthly action waits at most 168 hours for the first common real spot/perpetual open and is otherwise skipped. Remaining no-trade/outage gaps may carry the last causal close only for continuous MTM/basis diagnostics, never for a fill. Missing mark uses exact same-hour perpetual, then spot, then prior causal mark in that order. Every source count is reported in data_quality.json.

accounting: Separate adverse execution fills and fees for spot and perpetual on entry and exit
Spot directional PnL plus perpetual short directional PnL expose realised basis convergence/divergence
Funding is quantity times true archived mark-price open at each settlement times the archived rate
Full ledger books spot purchase/sale, futures margin lock/release, futures variation PnL, funding and all four fees
Hourly marked-to-market equity uses spot and mark price; ledger and episode PnL must reconcile
promotion_gate: Research cannot be live-approved from this retrospective replay. Paper-forward for at least 12 months and 12 independent closed episodes; require positive stress net PnL, positive stress result in each frozen historical window, zero modelled collateral exhaustion and live basis/cost tracking within stress assumptions.
known_limitations: Hourly opens approximate execution; funding uses the exact settlement-hour mark open, with verified 1m mark fallback where a 1h archive omits that hour

Sparse 1h spot/perpetual omissions first use exact same-hour public 1m observations; any remaining hours carry prior close only for MTM/basis diagnostics, while entries and exits require a real observation
Order-book impact, transfer latency, exchange outage/default, borrow constraints and taxes are absent
Maintenance-margin tiers and liquidation-engine mechanics are not modelled; collateral exhaustion is only a conservative diagnostic
The retrospective evaluation is protocol-frozen but is not prospective live evidence
At hours with no published 1h or 1m mark candle, exact same-hour perpetual/spot or prior causal mark proxies the mark in that order; counts are reported in data_quality.json
supersession_reason: Final pre-result execution-quality amendment: one planned monthly SOL action hour lacks both 1h and 1m perpetual observations. Atomic execution may wait up to seven days for a real common open; no strategy target, episode or PnL had been computed.
